svg.text: Jetson AGX Orin developer kit, 40-pin header
The header runs along the side beside the USB-A pair. Pin 1 is at the USB end, on the lower row,
marked by a white triangle on the PCB. Pin numbers are BOARD numbers, as in Jetson.GPIO.
7.4 V side: see the power figure.
At 5 V its pull-up puts 5 V on S, a
3.3 V pin: add a 10k/20k divider or
High only in AUTO; 1 kohm series
resistor on the board. Pin 22 is
Pins: yellow outline = in use. Colours: 5 V red, 3.3 V orange, GND green, I2C blue, GPIO purple, other grey.
